version.changelog:
DolphinDB Skill 2.0.0 — 全新升级，覆盖1490篇技术文档与3份官方白皮书，涵盖数据库、流计算、量化回测等全场景。

- 新增官方白皮书（数据库/流计算/量化回测）并分类组织，支持生产级架构与实战策略开发
- 技术文档全面扩展至1490篇，细分函数、引擎、运维、API等类别，提供完整索引
- 增加大量常见问题导航与实用代码示例，覆盖从新手入门到高级场景
- 对数据库设计、流计算、量化回测等全流程给出最佳实践和决策要点
- 明确按场景/角色查阅路径，为架构师、DBA、开发和量化研究等不同角色优化内容查找

llm.summary: This is a documentation-only DolphinDB skill, but some included examples use default admin passwords and destructive shell commands that could be unsafe if copied into real systems.

dimensions.detail: The artifact itself does not request runtime access, but its database administration references include high-impact operations such as administrator login, cluster replication credentials, and operating-system shell execution.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation guidance is user-directed and describes project and global skill directories; no installer, hooks, or automatic setup scripts were found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill is intended to help agents generate runnable DolphinDB scripts, while included reference examples contain admin/123456 credentials and an rm -rf shell example without strong local guardrails against production reuse.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No evidence of skill-installed persistence, background workers, privilege escalation, tool hijacking, or credential/session collection was found; persistence is limited to the user choosing a skill install location.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The package coherently presents itself as a DolphinDB technical documentation and best-practices corpus, with Markdown references and no executable files found.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you want a large DolphinDB documentation corpus available to your agent, and treat its examples as reference material rather than production-ready code. Replace all sample credentials, avoid default administrator accounts, keep shell execution disabled unless strictly needed, and manually review any generated deployment, replication, or filesystem-changing commands before running them.
llm.findings:
[AE1] expected: The cited whitepaper/reference files are present locally as Markdown and fit the large documentation-corpus purpose; inventory and keyword review did not show hidden runtime code, so this finding is downgraded.
[T09] expected: The hard-coded admin/123456 values are in static DolphinDB documentation examples and are not executed by the skill, but they remain a meaningful copy-paste risk for generated deployment or client guidance.
[T09] unexpected: The shell() reference demonstrates rm -rf against a path; that destructive recursive pattern is not needed for a safe API example and warrants review because the skill is meant to guide runnable script generation.
